Structural system assumption: RCC Frame with 5.5 in solid slab.
Column count: 23 columns positioned along structural walls and envelope.
Preliminary beam count: 28 beams connecting column grid nodes.
Clearance verified: Zero column obstruction of door openings, stairs, and parking.
Multi-floor alignment: Columns stack continuously from ground to top floor.

column_alignment_issues: [INFO] Single story residence: Direct vertical load path ground-to-roof.
validation_report.summary: Preliminary structural checks verified 23 column positions and 28 preliminary beams. All spatial clearances satisfied.

slab_assumptions.span_assumption: Maximum clear span recommended <= 16 ft without intermediate beam.
